title: 日常沟通精选 · 124 句
description: 从基础请求进阶到日常叙事、条件、比较和感受表达；前 30 题保留原题及 ID。

items.zh: 我今天很忙。
items.en: I'm busy today.
answers: I'm busy today.
I am busy today.
items.notes: be busy 表示忙碌；today 作时间状语。

items.zh: 我现在有空。
items.en: I'm free now.
answers: I'm free now.
I am free now.
items.notes: free 在此表示有空，不是免费；now 表示现在。

items.zh: 请说慢一点。
items.en: Please speak more slowly.
answers: Please speak more slowly.
items.notes: speak slowly 表示慢慢说；more slowly 是副词比较级。

items.zh: 我没听清。
items.en: I didn't hear you clearly.
answers: I didn't hear you clearly.
I did not hear you clearly.
items.notes: did not 后接动词原形 hear；clearly 修饰听到的程度。

items.zh: 你能重复一遍吗？
items.en: Could you repeat that?
answers: Could you repeat that?
items.notes: could you 用于礼貌请求；repeat 表示重复，无需再加 again。

items.zh: 这是什么意思？
items.en: What does this mean?
answers: What does this mean?
items.notes: what does ... mean 用于询问含义；助动词后 mean 用原形。

items.zh: 你需要什么？
items.en: What do you need?
answers: What do you need?
items.notes: what 作 need 的宾语；问句使用 do 提问。

items.zh: 我需要帮助。
items.en: I need help.
answers: I need help.
items.notes: need 直接接宾语 help；help 在此通常不可数。

items.zh: 我稍后给你回电话。
items.en: I'll call you back later.
answers: I'll call you back later.
I will call you back later.
items.notes: call sb back 表示回电话；代词放在 call 与 back 之间。

items.zh: 我正在开会。
items.en: I'm in a meeting.
answers: I'm in a meeting.
I am in a meeting.
items.notes: be in a meeting 表示正在开会。

items.zh: 请发邮件给我。
items.en: Please email me.
answers: Please email me.
items.notes: email 可以作及物动词，后面直接接收件人。

items.zh: 我已经发给你了。
items.en: I've sent it to you.
answers: I've sent it to you.
I have sent it to you.
items.notes: have sent 为现在完成时，强调发送已经完成。

items.zh: 文件在附件里。
items.en: The file is attached.
answers: The file is attached.
items.notes: be attached 表示已作为附件附上；正式邮件中常用。

items.zh: 我会检查一下。
items.en: I'll check it.
answers: I'll check it.
I will check it.
items.notes: will check 表示承诺或临时决定检查。

items.zh: 我们可以明天见吗？
items.en: Can we meet tomorrow?
answers: Can we meet tomorrow?
items.notes: can we ... 用于提出共同安排；tomorrow 前不加介词。

items.zh: 时间对我来说合适。
items.en: The time works for me.
answers: The time works for me.
items.notes: work for sb 在此表示某安排对某人合适。

items.zh: 抱歉，我迟到了。
items.en: Sorry I'm late.
answers: Sorry I'm late.
Sorry I am late.
items.notes: sorry 后可省略 that；be late 表示迟到。

items.zh: 谢谢你的耐心。
items.en: Thank you for your patience.
answers: Thank you for your patience.
items.notes: thank sb for + 名词或动名词；patience 为不可数名词。

items.zh: 这件事很重要。
items.en: This is important.
answers: This is important.
items.notes: important 为形容词，放在系动词 is 后。

items.zh: 我们需要一个计划。
items.en: We need a plan.
answers: We need a plan.
items.notes: plan 为可数名词，单数前加 a。

items.zh: 先从简单的开始。
items.en: Let's start with something simple.
answers: Let's start with something simple.
items.notes: let's + 动词原形提出建议；形容词 simple 放在 something 后。

items.zh: 请记住这一点。
items.en: Please remember this.
answers: Please remember this.
items.notes: remember this 表示记住这一点；please 使提醒更礼貌。

items.zh: 我同意你的看法。
items.en: I agree with you.
answers: I agree with you.
items.notes: agree with sb 表示同意某人；agree 是动词，不要写成 am agree。

items.zh: 我不完全同意。
items.en: I don't completely agree.
answers: I don't completely agree.
I do not completely agree.
items.notes: don't completely agree 表示不完全赞同，语气弱于完全反对。

items.zh: 让我们换个话题。
items.en: Let's change the subject.
answers: Let's change the subject.
items.notes: change the subject 表示转换话题，不是更换主语。

items.zh: 你有什么建议？
items.en: What do you suggest?
answers: What do you suggest?
items.notes: suggest 为动词，表示建议；问句用 do 提问。

items.zh: 这取决于情况。
items.en: It depends on the situation.
answers: It depends on the situation.
items.notes: depend on 为固定搭配，表示取决于。

items.zh: 我会尽快处理。
items.en: I'll handle it as soon as possible.
answers: I'll handle it as soon as possible.
I will handle it as soon as possible.
items.notes: as soon as possible 表示尽快；handle 表示处理。

items.zh: 一切都准备好了。
items.en: Everything is ready.
answers: Everything is ready.
items.notes: everything 作单数主语，谓语用 is；ready 是形容词。

items.zh: 我们还缺什么？
items.en: What are we still missing?
answers: What are we still missing?
items.notes: be missing sth 表示仍缺少某物；still 表示仍然。

items.zh: 我差点忘了把钥匙带走。
items.en: I almost forgot to take my keys.
answers: I almost forgot to take my keys.
items.notes: forget to do 表示忘记要做的事；almost 表示差一点。

items.zh: 你到家后给我发个消息吧。
items.en: Send me a message when you get home.
answers: Send me a message when you get home.
items.notes: when 引导将来的时间从句时用现在时；get home 不加 to。

items.zh: 冰箱里剩下的牛奶够明天早餐用吗？
items.en: Is there enough milk left in the fridge for breakfast tomorrow?
answers: Is there enough milk left in the fridge for breakfast tomorrow?
items.notes: enough 放在名词 milk 前；left 作后置修饰，表示剩下的。

items.zh: 如果外面下雨，我们就在里面等。
items.en: If it's raining outside, we'll wait inside.
answers: If it's raining outside, we'll wait inside.
If it's raining outside, we will wait inside.
items.notes: if + 现在进行时描述条件，主句 will 表示决定。

items.zh: 这件外套比看起来暖和。
items.en: This coat is warmer than it looks.
answers: This coat is warmer than it looks.
items.notes: warmer than 用于比较；looks 后省略重复的形容词。

items.zh: 我找了半天，才发现眼镜就在头上。
items.en: After searching for ages, I realized my glasses were on my head.
answers: After searching for ages, I realized my glasses were on my head.
items.notes: for ages 在口语中表示很久；glasses 作复数，谓语用 were。

items.zh: 虽然路不远，但带着这些袋子走过去并不轻松。
items.en: Although it isn't far, walking there with these bags isn't easy.
answers: Although it isn't far, walking there with these bags isn't easy.
Although it is not far, walking there with these bags is not easy.
items.notes: although 引出让步；walking ... 是动名词主语。

items.zh: 你介意把音乐调小一点吗？
items.en: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
answers: Would you mind turning the music down a little?
items.notes: would you mind 后接 doing；turn down 表示调低音量。

items.zh: 我刚要出门，门铃就响了。
items.en: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.
answers: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.
items.notes: be about to do ... when ... 表示正要做某事时发生了另一件事。

items.zh: 把容易碎的东西放在最上面。
items.en: Put the fragile items on top.
answers: Put the fragile items on top.
items.notes: fragile 表示易碎的；on top 表示在最上面。

items.zh: 这就是我昨天跟你提过的那家店。
items.en: This is the shop I told you about yesterday.
answers: This is the shop I told you about yesterday.
items.notes: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 shop；tell sb about sth 表示向某人介绍。

items.zh: 我还没决定今晚做什么吃。
items.en: I haven't decided what to cook tonight yet.
answers: I haven't decided what to cook tonight yet.
I have not decided what to cook tonight yet.
items.notes: what to cook 是疑问词加不定式；yet 表示截至现在仍未完成。

items.zh: 与其等下一班车，我们不如走过去。
items.en: Rather than wait for the next bus, let's walk.
answers: Rather than wait for the next bus, let's walk.
items.notes: rather than 后用动词原形；let's 提出共同建议。

items.zh: 让我惊讶的是，大家都记得我的生日。
items.en: What surprised me was that everyone remembered my birthday.
answers: What surprised me was that everyone remembered my birthday.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；everyone 表示每个人，谓语按单数处理。

items.zh: 只要十点前回来，你可以借我的自行车。
items.en: You can borrow my bike as long as you're back before ten.
answers: You can borrow my bike as long as you're back before ten.
You can borrow my bike as long as you are back before ten.
items.notes: borrow 表示借入；as long as 提出条件，be back 表示回来。

items.zh: 我们到电影院时，电影已经开始了。
items.en: By the time we got to the cinema, the film had already started.
answers: By the time we got to the cinema, the film had already started.
items.notes: 过去完成时说明电影开始早于到达；by the time 表示到……的时候。

items.zh: 这个盒子太重了，我一个人搬不动。
items.en: This box is too heavy for me to carry on my own.
answers: This box is too heavy for me to carry on my own.
items.notes: too + 形容词 + for sb to do 表示超出能力；on my own 表示独自。

items.zh: 你把伞忘在我这里了，下次见面我带给你。
items.en: You left your umbrella at my place; I'll bring it next time we meet.
answers: You left your umbrella at my place; I'll bring it next time we meet.
You left your umbrella at my place; I will bring it next time we meet.
items.notes: leave sth somewhere 表示把东西落在某处；next time 引导时间从句。

items.zh: 我已经习惯早起，但周末仍然喜欢多睡一会儿。
items.en: I'm used to getting up early, but I still like sleeping in on weekends.
answers: I'm used to getting up early, but I still like sleeping in on weekends.
I am used to getting up early, but I still like sleeping in on weekends.
items.notes: be used to doing 表示习惯于；sleep in 表示比平时晚起。

items.zh: 我们能找一个不用大声说话也能听清的地方吗？
items.en: Can we find somewhere we can hear each other without shouting?
answers: Can we find somewhere we can hear each other without shouting?
items.notes: somewhere 后接省略 where 的定语从句；without 后用 doing。

items.zh: 看起来有人在我不在的时候给植物浇过水。
items.en: It looks as though someone watered the plants while I was away.
answers: It looks as though someone watered the plants while I was away.
items.notes: it looks as though 表示看起来似乎；while I was away 指离开的那段时间。

items.zh: 我宁愿早点出发，也不想一路赶时间。
items.en: I'd rather leave early than rush the whole way.
answers: I'd rather leave early than rush the whole way.
items.notes: would rather do A than do B 比较偏好，两处都用动词原形。

items.zh: 这块地方刚拖过地，小心别滑倒。
items.en: This area has just been mopped, so be careful not to slip.
answers: This area has just been mopped, so be careful not to slip.
items.notes: 现在完成时被动说明刚完成的动作；be careful not to do 表示小心别做。

items.zh: 除了门口那把椅子，其他座位都有人了。
items.en: All the seats are taken except the chair by the door.
answers: All the seats are taken except the chair by the door.
items.notes: be taken 表示座位已被占用；except 表示排除例外。

items.zh: 没想到这么快就修好了。
items.en: I didn't expect it to be fixed so quickly.
answers: I didn't expect it to be fixed so quickly.
I did not expect it to be fixed so quickly.
items.notes: expect + 宾语 + to do；to be fixed 是被动不定式。

items.zh: 我们上次见面已经快一年了。
items.en: It's been almost a year since we last met.
answers: It's been almost a year since we last met.
items.notes: it has been + 一段时间 + since ... 表示从某事到现在经过多久。

items.zh: 无论你选哪家餐厅，我都可以。
items.en: Whichever restaurant you choose is fine with me.
answers: Whichever restaurant you choose is fine with me.
items.notes: whichever ... 作主语，表示你选择的任何一家；be fine with sb 表示某人可以接受。

items.zh: 如果我早知道你也要来，就会多做一点。
items.en: If I'd known you were coming too, I would have made more.
answers: If I'd known you were coming too, I would have made more.
items.notes: 过去虚拟条件句表示与过去事实相反的假设；made more 省略语境已知的食物。

items.zh: 这件事比我预想的多花了些时间，不过现在已经完成了。
items.en: This took a little longer than I expected, but it's finished now.
answers: This took a little longer than I expected, but it's finished now.
items.notes: a little 修饰比较级 longer；转折补充当前完成状态。

items.zh: 能不能把地址拼给我听？我想确认自己记对了。
items.en: Could you spell out the address for me? I want to make sure I've got it right.
answers: Could you spell out the address for me? I want to make sure I've got it right.
Could you spell out the address for me? I want to make sure I have got it right.
items.notes: spell out 表示逐字母拼出；get it right 表示弄对。

items.zh: 我把门开着，让新鲜空气进来。
items.en: I left the door open to let some fresh air in.
answers: I left the door open to let some fresh air in.
items.notes: leave + 宾语 + 形容词。

items.zh: 水壶里的水还热吗？
items.en: Is the water in the kettle still hot?
answers: Is the water in the kettle still hot?
items.notes: still：仍然。

items.zh: 这条毛巾还没干，先用另一条吧。
items.en: This towel is still damp; use another one for now.
answers: This towel is still damp; use another one for now.
items.notes: for now：暂时。

items.zh: 我去楼下扔垃圾，马上就上来。
items.en: I am taking the rubbish downstairs and will be back in a minute.
answers: I am taking the rubbish downstairs and will be back in a minute.
I'm taking the rubbish downstairs and will be back in a minute.
items.notes: in a minute：很快，稍后。

items.zh: 你能把那个够不到的盒子递给我吗？
items.en: Could you pass me the box I cannot reach?
answers: Could you pass me the box I cannot reach?
Could you pass me the box I can't reach?
items.notes: reach：伸手够到。

items.zh: 门外好像有人在叫我的名字。
items.en: Someone outside seems to be calling my name.
answers: Someone outside seems to be calling my name.
items.notes: seem to be doing：似乎正在。

items.zh: 别把热锅直接放在桌上。
items.en: Do not put the hot pan directly on the table.
answers: Do not put the hot pan directly on the table.
Don't put the hot pan directly on the table.
items.notes: directly：直接地。

items.zh: 我忘了关灯，但幸好你看到了。
items.en: I forgot to turn off the light, but luckily you noticed.
answers: I forgot to turn off the light, but luckily you noticed.
items.notes: forget to do：忘记要做的事。

items.zh: 这把剪刀剪不动厚纸板。
items.en: These scissors cannot cut through thick cardboard.
answers: These scissors cannot cut through thick cardboard.
These scissors can't cut through thick cardboard.
items.notes: scissors 通常用复数。

items.zh: 把袋子系紧，里面的东西才不会掉出来。
items.en: Tie the bag securely so that nothing falls out.
answers: Tie the bag securely so that nothing falls out.
items.notes: fall out：掉出来。

items.zh: 我会把易坏的食物先放进冰箱。
items.en: I will put the perishable food in the fridge first.
answers: I will put the perishable food in the fridge first.
I'll put the perishable food in the fridge first.
items.notes: perishable：容易变质的。

items.zh: 我们还有足够的盘子给所有人用吗？
items.en: Do we have enough plates for everyone?
answers: Do we have enough plates for everyone?
items.notes: enough + 名词。

items.zh: 这块面包闻起来有点不对劲。
items.en: This bread smells a little odd.
answers: This bread smells a little odd.
items.notes: smell 后接形容词。

items.zh: 菜还有几分钟就好了。
items.en: The food will be ready in a few minutes.
answers: The food will be ready in a few minutes.
items.notes: in a few minutes：几分钟后。

items.zh: 我刚吃过，所以现在不太饿。
items.en: I have just eaten, so I am not very hungry now.
answers: I have just eaten, so I am not very hungry now.
I've just eaten, so I'm not very hungry now.
items.notes: have just done：刚刚做过。

items.zh: 汤洒在袖子上了，我得换件衣服。
items.en: I spilled soup on my sleeve and need to get changed.
answers: I spilled soup on my sleeve and need to get changed.
items.notes: get changed：换衣服。

items.zh: 你想现在吃，还是等其他人到？
items.en: Would you like to eat now or wait for the others?
answers: Would you like to eat now or wait for the others?
items.notes: wait for sb：等某人。

items.zh: 我把需要买的东西记在手机上了。
items.en: I have listed what we need to buy on my phone.
answers: I have listed what we need to buy on my phone.
I've listed what we need to buy on my phone.
items.notes: list 作动词表示列出。

items.zh: 商店关门前，我们还有二十分钟。
items.en: We have twenty minutes before the shop closes.
answers: We have twenty minutes before the shop closes.
items.notes: before 从句用现在时。

items.zh: 这件衬衫洗过后缩水了。
items.en: This shirt shrank after it was washed.
answers: This shirt shrank after it was washed.
items.notes: shrank 是 shrink 的过去式。

items.zh: 颜色我喜欢，但尺寸不合适。
items.en: I like the colour, but the size is wrong.
answers: I like the colour, but the size is wrong.
items.notes: wrong 在此表示不合适。

items.zh: 这个拉链卡住了，别用力拉。
items.en: The zip is stuck; do not force it.
answers: The zip is stuck; do not force it.
The zip is stuck; don't force it.
items.notes: force 在此表示硬拉或强行操作。

items.zh: 我把零钱放在外套口袋里了。
items.en: I put the loose change in my coat pocket.
answers: I put the loose change in my coat pocket.
items.notes: loose change：零钱。

items.zh: 这张纸上有地址，别把它扔掉。
items.en: The address is on this piece of paper, so do not throw it away.
answers: The address is on this piece of paper, so do not throw it away.
The address is on this piece of paper, so don't throw it away.
items.notes: throw away：扔掉。

items.zh: 我没听到闹钟响，因此起晚了。
items.en: I did not hear the alarm go off, so I overslept.
answers: I did not hear the alarm go off, so I overslept.
I didn't hear the alarm go off, so I overslept.
items.notes: go off 指闹钟响起。

items.zh: 今天我需要多留一点出门时间。
items.en: I need to allow extra time to get ready today.
answers: I need to allow extra time to get ready today.
items.notes: allow time：留出时间。

items.zh: 外面比早上冷，最好带件外套。
items.en: It is colder outside than this morning; taking a jacket would be sensible.
answers: It is colder outside than this morning; taking a jacket would be sensible.
items.notes: sensible：合适、明智的。

items.zh: 我们在有顶棚的入口见面吧。
items.en: Let's meet at the covered entrance.
answers: Let's meet at the covered entrance.
items.notes: covered：有遮挡顶棚的。

items.zh: 你到了附近再给我打电话。
items.en: Call me when you are nearby.
answers: Call me when you are nearby.
items.notes: nearby 作表语，表示在附近。

items.zh: 我会在十字路口等，不会挡住门口。
items.en: I will wait at the crossroads rather than block the doorway.
answers: I will wait at the crossroads rather than block the doorway.
I'll wait at the crossroads rather than block the doorway.
items.notes: rather than 对比位置选择。

items.zh: 你走得有点快，我快跟不上了。
items.en: You are walking a little fast; I can barely keep up.
answers: You are walking a little fast; I can barely keep up.
items.notes: keep up：跟上。

items.zh: 我想停一下，把鞋带系好。
items.en: I want to stop and tie my shoelaces.
answers: I want to stop and tie my shoelaces.
items.notes: tie shoelaces：系鞋带。

items.zh: 我们刚才经过的店里好像有这个。
items.en: The shop we just passed seemed to have this.
answers: The shop we just passed seemed to have this.
items.notes: 省略关系代词的定语从句。

items.zh: 我记得这个路口，但不记得应该往哪边走。
items.en: I remember this junction but not which way to go.
answers: I remember this junction but not which way to go.
items.notes: which way to go：走哪个方向。

items.zh: 雨下得更大了，我们先找个地方避雨。
items.en: The rain is getting heavier; let's find shelter first.
answers: The rain is getting heavier; let's find shelter first.
items.notes: get heavier：变得更大。

items.zh: 这张椅子有点晃，换一张吧。
items.en: This chair is wobbly; let's use another one.
answers: This chair is wobbly; let's use another one.
items.notes: wobbly：不稳、摇晃的。

items.zh: 你愿意帮我按住这一头吗？
items.en: Would you hold this end for me?
answers: Would you hold this end for me?
items.notes: hold：按住、扶住。

items.zh: 我已经试了两次，还没有成功。
items.en: I have tried twice without success.
answers: I have tried twice without success.
I've tried twice without success.
items.notes: without success：没有成功。

items.zh: 也许我们把顺序弄反了。
items.en: Perhaps we have done it in the wrong order.
answers: Perhaps we have done it in the wrong order.
Perhaps we've done it in the wrong order.
items.notes: in the wrong order：顺序错误。

items.zh: 先别急着扔，我想再检查一下。
items.en: Do not throw it out yet; I want to check it once more.
answers: Do not throw it out yet; I want to check it once more.
Don't throw it out yet; I want to check it once more.
items.notes: yet 用于尚未完成的否定要求。

items.zh: 我以为你已经知道了，所以没有再提。
items.en: I assumed you already knew, so I did not mention it again.
answers: I assumed you already knew, so I did not mention it again.
I assumed you already knew, so I didn't mention it again.
items.notes: assume：未经确认地以为。

items.zh: 我说的是另一个名字相似的人。
items.en: I meant a different person with a similar name.
answers: I meant a different person with a similar name.
items.notes: meant 是 mean 的过去式。

items.zh: 能举个例子，让我更容易理解吗？
items.en: Could you give an example to make it easier for me to understand?
answers: Could you give an example to make it easier for me to understand?
items.notes: make it easier for sb to do。

items.zh: 我只记得大概意思，不记得原话。
items.en: I remember the general idea but not the exact words.
answers: I remember the general idea but not the exact words.
items.notes: exact words：原话。

items.zh: 这件事没有听起来那么复杂。
items.en: It is not as complicated as it sounds.
answers: It is not as complicated as it sounds.
It isn't as complicated as it sounds.
items.notes: not as ... as：没有那么。

items.zh: 我得想一想，不能马上给你答案。
items.en: I need to think about it and cannot give you an answer immediately.
answers: I need to think about it and cannot give you an answer immediately.
I need to think about it and can't give you an answer immediately.
items.notes: think about：考虑。

items.zh: 如果时间有变，我会提前告诉你。
items.en: I will let you know in advance if the time changes.
answers: I will let you know in advance if the time changes.
I'll let you know in advance if the time changes.
items.notes: let sb know：告知。

items.zh: 我们先定个暂定时间，之后再确认。
items.en: Let's choose a provisional time and confirm it later.
answers: Let's choose a provisional time and confirm it later.
items.notes: provisional：暂定的。

items.zh: 我不想答应了以后又让你失望。
items.en: I do not want to make a promise and then let you down.
answers: I do not want to make a promise and then let you down.
I don't want to make a promise and then let you down.
items.notes: let sb down：让某人失望。

items.zh: 你已经帮了很多，这部分让我来吧。
items.en: You have already helped a lot; let me handle this part.
answers: You have already helped a lot; let me handle this part.
items.notes: handle：处理、负责。

items.zh: 今天没有我预想的那么顺利。
items.en: Today did not go as smoothly as I expected.
answers: Today did not go as smoothly as I expected.
Today didn't go as smoothly as I expected.
items.notes: go smoothly：进展顺利。

items.zh: 好在我们还有时间调整。
items.en: Fortunately, we still have time to make changes.
answers: Fortunately, we still have time to make changes.
items.notes: fortunately：幸运的是。

items.zh: 我需要把注意力集中在手头这件事上。
items.en: I need to concentrate on the task at hand.
answers: I need to concentrate on the task at hand.
items.notes: at hand：当前的。

items.zh: 旁边太吵了，我们换到安静一点的地方吧。
items.en: It is too noisy here; let's move somewhere quieter.
answers: It is too noisy here; let's move somewhere quieter.
items.notes: somewhere 后接形容词。

items.zh: 我刚刚分心了，最后一句能再说一下吗？
items.en: I lost concentration for a moment; could you repeat the last sentence?
answers: I lost concentration for a moment; could you repeat the last sentence?
items.notes: lose concentration：走神。

items.zh: 我想早点处理完，这样晚上就不用惦记了。
items.en: I want to finish it early so that I do not have to think about it tonight.
answers: I want to finish it early so that I do not have to think about it tonight.
I want to finish it early so that I don't have to think about it tonight.
items.notes: so that 引出预期目的。

items.zh: 我终于找到了，一直就在抽屉最里面。
items.en: I finally found it; it had been at the back of the drawer all along.
answers: I finally found it; it had been at the back of the drawer all along.
items.notes: all along：一直。

items.zh: 我们没有浪费这趟路，至少弄清了地点。
items.en: The trip was not wasted; at least we found out where it was.
answers: The trip was not wasted; at least we found out where it was.
The trip wasn't wasted; at least we found out where it was.
items.notes: at least：至少。

items.zh: 我没料到这个小改动会省下这么多时间。
items.en: I did not expect this small change to save so much time.
answers: I did not expect this small change to save so much time.
I didn't expect this small change to save so much time.
items.notes: expect sth to do。

items.zh: 现在不方便说话，我到家后再联系你。
items.en: I cannot talk now; I will contact you after I get home.
answers: I cannot talk now; I will contact you after I get home.
I can't talk now; I'll contact you after I get home.
items.notes: after 引导将来时间用现在时。

items.zh: 我会把你的东西放到一边，免得和别人的混在一起。
items.en: I will put your things aside so that they do not get mixed up with anyone else's.
answers: I will put your things aside so that they do not get mixed up with anyone else's.
I'll put your things aside so that they don't get mixed up with anyone else's.
items.notes: get mixed up with：混在一起。

items.zh: 你不用等我，我还需要一会儿。
items.en: You do not need to wait for me; I will be a while.
answers: You do not need to wait for me; I will be a while.
You don't need to wait for me; I'll be a while.
items.notes: be a while：还要一段时间。

items.zh: 即使计划没按原样进行，我们也可以灵活调整。
items.en: Even if the plan does not work out as intended, we can adapt.
answers: Even if the plan does not work out as intended, we can adapt.
Even if the plan doesn't work out as intended, we can adapt.
items.notes: work out as intended：按原计划实现。

items.zh: 我现在明白你为什么建议这么做了。
items.en: I now understand why you suggested doing it this way.
answers: I now understand why you suggested doing it this way.
items.notes: suggest 后接动名词。
